khmer: ច្បាប់ (សម្រាប់សំបុត្រ)
breakdown: 土(earth)+土+寸 — sealing a letter with earth/clay; now the measure word for sealed letters

examples.py: Wǒ xiě le yì fēng xìn.
Zhè fēng xìn shì gěi nǐ de.
Tā shōu dào le liǎng fēng xìn.
Wǒ gěi māma jì le yì fēng xìn.
examples.en: I mailed a letter to my mom.

khmer: សំបុត្រ / ជឿ
breakdown: 亻(person radical)+言(words) — a person's words sent to another, a letter

examples.py: Tā hái méi huí wǒ de xìn.
examples.en: He hasn't replied to my letter yet.

examples.py: Qǐng bǎ xìn fàng jìn xìnfēng.
examples.en: Please put the letter in the envelope.

breakdown: 收(receive, gather)+到(reach) — something reaches you and you take it in

examples.py: Wǒ shōu dào le nǐ de xìn.
Nǐ shōu dào xiāoxi le ma?
Wǒ shōu dào le yí ge lǐwù.
Tā shōu dào le hěn duō zhùhè.
Wǒ hái méi shōu dào dá'àn.
examples.en: I haven't received the answer yet.

breakdown: 原(original)+谅(understand, 讠speech radical) — understanding the original reason and letting it go

examples.py: Tā yuánliàng le wǒ de cuòwù.
Zhè jiàn shì hěn nán yuánliàng.
Yuánliàng biéren yě shì bāng zìjǐ.

khmer: អ្វីៗទាំងអស់
breakdown: 一(one)+切(cut, all) — all cut together into one whole

examples.py: Gǎnxiè nǐ wèi wǒ zuò de yíqiè.
examples.en: Thank you for everything you did for me.
Health is more important than everything.

english: in the blink of an eye
khmer: ក្នុងមួយប៉ប្រិចភ្នែក
breakdown: 转(turn)+眼(eye) — in the time it takes to turn your eyes

examples.en: In the blink of an eye a year has passed.
Winter arrived in the blink of an eye.

examples.py: Háizi zhuǎnyǎn jiù zhǎng dà le.
examples.en: The child grew up in no time.
Before we knew it, we graduated.

examples.cn: 时间过得真快，转眼又是新年。
examples.py: Shíjiān guò de zhēn kuài, zhuǎnyǎn yòu shì xīnnián.
examples.en: Time flies, and suddenly it's New Year again.

breakdown: 去(gone, past)+年(year) — the year that has gone

examples.en: I went to China last year.

examples.cn: 去年的今天我们见面了。
examples.py: Qùnián de jīntiān wǒmen jiànmiàn le.
examples.en: A year ago today we met.

khmer: ព្រួយចិត្ត
breakdown: 难(difficult)+过(to pass) — a time that is hard to get through

examples.cn: 听到这个消息她很难过。
examples.py: Tīng dào zhège xiāoxi tā hěn nánguò.
examples.en: She was very sad to hear this news.
He was so sad he cried.

examples.cn: 考试没考好，我有点难过。
examples.py: Kǎoshì méi kǎo hǎo, wǒ yǒudiǎn nánguò.
examples.en: I didn't do well on the exam, I feel a bit down.

breakdown: 一(one)+定(fixed) — fixed as one certain way

examples.py: Rènzhēn fùxí yídìng néng kǎo hǎo.
examples.en: Reviewing seriously will surely get good results.

examples.py: Zhè jiàn shì bù yídìng shì zhēn de.

breakdown: 程(stage, procedure)+度(degree) — how far along a scale something is

examples.py: Tā de Hànyǔ chéngdù hěn gāo.

examples.cn: 你的中文到什么程度了？
examples.py: Nǐ de Zhōngwén dào shénme chéngdù le?
examples.en: What level has your Chinese reached?
This class's level is about the same.
The extent of pollution is serious.

examples.cn: 我很喜欢他，喜欢到不能没有他的程度。
examples.py: Wǒ hěn xǐhuan tā, xǐhuan dào bù néng méiyǒu tā de chéngdù.
examples.en: I like him to the degree that I can't be without him.

breakdown: 提(lift up)+高(high) — lifting something higher

examples.en: Practicing more can raise your level.

examples.py: Wǒ xiǎng tígāo wǒ de Zhōngwén.
examples.en: I want to improve my Chinese.

examples.cn: 阅读可以提高理解能力。
及时复习效果更好，能提高分数。
examples.py: Jíshí fùxí xiàoguǒ gèng hǎo, néng tígāo fēnshù.
examples.en: Reviewing promptly works better and can raise your score.

khmer: ចង (មិត្ត) / ប្រគល់
breakdown: Whole shape — two lines crossing, like people or things coming together

examples.py: Wǒ jiāo le hěn duō péngyou.
Qǐng bǎ zuòyè jiāo gěi lǎoshī.
examples.en: Please hand the homework to the teacher.

examples.py: Wǒ xiǎng hé nǐ jiāo ge péngyou.
examples.en: I'd like to make friends with you.

khmer: មិនត្រឹមតែ
breakdown: 不(not)+但(only) — 'not only this'

examples.en: He is not only clever, but also hardworking.

examples.cn: 这里不但干净，而且安静。
examples.en: This place is not only clean, but also quiet.

examples.cn: 我不但会说汉语，还会写汉字。
examples.py: Wǒ búdàn huì shuō Hànyǔ, hái huì xiě Hànzì.
examples.en: I can not only speak Chinese, but also write characters.

examples.cn: 他不但迟到了，还忘了带书。
examples.py: Tā búdàn chídào le, hái wàng le dài shū.
examples.en: He was not only late, he also forgot his book.

examples.cn: 这个办法不但简单，而且有用。
examples.py: Zhège bànfǎ búdàn jiǎndān, érqiě yǒuyòng.
examples.en: This method is not only simple, but also useful.

breakdown: 而(and)+且(also) — 'and also'

examples.en: This dish is tasty, and also cheap.

examples.py: Tā hěn máng, érqiě hěn lèi.
examples.en: He is very busy, and also very tired.

examples.cn: 她会说汉语，而且说得很好。
examples.py: Tā huì shuō Hànyǔ, érqiě shuō de hěn hǎo.
examples.en: She can speak Chinese, and speaks it very well.

examples.cn: 这里的东西新鲜，而且不贵。
examples.py: Zhèlǐ de dōngxi xīnxiān, érqiě bú guì.
examples.en: The things here are fresh, and not expensive.

examples.cn: 我认识他，而且我们是同事。
examples.py: Wǒ rènshi tā, érqiě wǒmen shì tóngshì.
examples.en: I know him, and we are colleagues too.

breakdown: 世(era, generation)+界(boundary) — all the lands within the boundaries of the age

examples.en: I want to see the world.

examples.py: Zhè shì shìjiè shàng zuì cháng de hé.
examples.en: This is the longest river in the world.

examples.py: Shìjiè shàng yǒu hěn duō guójiā.
examples.en: There are many countries in the world.

examples.cn: 他很有名，全世界都知道。
examples.py: Tā hěn yǒumíng, quán shìjiè dōu zhīdào.
examples.en: He is famous, the whole world knows him.

breakdown: Whole shape — pointing to each separate one

examples.py: Gè guó de wénhuà dōu bù yíyàng.
Gè rén yǒu gè rén de fāngfǎ.
examples.en: Each person has their own method.
Please each prepare your own materials.

khmer: គ្នាទៅវិញទៅមក
breakdown: 互(mutual)+相(each other) — two 'each other' characters together

examples.en: We learn languages from each other.

khmer: កាន់តែ...ឡើងៗ
breakdown: 越(the more)+来(come)+越(the more) — as it goes on, more and more

examples.py: Tiānqì yuè lái yuè lěng le.
examples.en: The weather is getting colder and colder.

examples.py: Wǒ yuè lái yuè xǐhuan Hànyǔ.
examples.en: I like Chinese more and more.

examples.py: Tā de Zhōngwén yuè lái yuè hǎo.
examples.en: His Chinese is getting better and better.

examples.py: Chéngshì lǐ de rén yuè lái yuè duō.
examples.en: There are more and more people in the city.

examples.py: Tā yuè lái yuè yǒu xìnxīn le.
examples.en: She is getting more and more confident.

english: the frame for fractions and percent (X分之Y)
khmer: ភាគ (ទម្រង់ប្រភាគ)
breakdown: 分(divide, part)+之(of) — 'parts of', the frame 三分之一 = one third, 百分之十 = ten percent

examples.py: Zhè shì sān fēn zhī yī.

examples.cn: 百分之八十的学生同意。
examples.py: Bǎi fēn zhī bāshí de xuésheng tóngyì.
Jiàgé jiàngdī le bǎi fēn zhī shí.
examples.en: The price dropped by ten percent.

examples.py: Wǒmen wánchéng le sì fēn zhī sān.
Bǎi fēn zhī bǎi wǒ huì lái.

english: (after a verb: marks a past experience)
khmer: ធ្លាប់ (បច្ច័យ)
breakdown: 辶(walking radical)+寸 — passing through; as a particle it marks that you have 'passed through' doing something

examples.py: Wǒ méi kàn guo zhè bù diànyǐng.
Tā xué guo sān nián Hànyǔ.
examples.en: He has studied Chinese for three years.

khmer: អក្សរចិនសាមញ្ញ
breakdown: 简(simple)+化(transform)+字(character) — characters that have been made simpler

examples.cn: 简化字比繁体字少笔画。
examples.en: Simplified characters have fewer strokes than traditional ones.
How do you write this simplified character?
Simplified characters are a bit easier to learn.

english: to carry out; to be in progress
khmer: ដំណើរការ / អនុវត្ត
breakdown: 进(advance)+行(go) — moving forward with an activity

examples.py: Wǒmen jìnxíng le yí cì diàochá.

examples.cn: 我们进行了一次会话练习。
examples.py: Wǒmen jìnxíng le yí cì huìhuà liànxí.

breakdown: 会(meet)+话(speech) — meeting and speaking together

examples.py: Shū lǐ yǒu hěn duō huìhuà.
examples.en: There are many dialogues in the book.

examples.cn: 练习会话可以提高水平。

breakdown: 将(about to)+来(come) — what is about to come

examples.en: What do you want to do in the future?
In the future I want to be a teacher.

examples.py: Jiānglái de shì hěn nán shuō.
examples.en: Future things are hard to say.
For the future, work hard now.

examples.py: Tā duì jiānglái hěn yǒu xìnxīn.
examples.en: He is confident about the future.

breakdown: 基(base, foundation)+本(root) — the base and the root

examples.py: Tā de Zhōngwén jīběn méi wèntí.

examples.cn: 我们要先学基本的语法。
examples.py: Wǒmen yào xiān xué jīběn de yǔfǎ.
examples.en: We should learn basic grammar first.

khmer: បញ្ជីមុខម្ហូប
breakdown: 菜(dish)+单(list) — a list of dishes

examples.py: Zhè jiā fàndiàn de càidān hěn cháng.
examples.en: This restaurant's menu is very long.

examples.py: Wǒ kàn bu dǒng Zhōngwén càidān.
examples.en: I can't read a Chinese menu.
There are pictures on the menu.

breakdown: 中(China)+餐(meal) — a Chinese meal

examples.en: Chinese food and Western food are different.

khmer: ពិតប្រាកដ / ដើមកំណើត
breakdown: 地(place, local)+道(way) — done the true local way

examples.cn: 他说一口地道的普通话。
examples.py: Tā shuō yì kǒu dìdao de pǔtōnghuà.
Zhè jiā diàn de wèidao hěn dìdao.
examples.en: This shop's flavor is very authentic.

examples.py: Wǒ xiǎng xué dìdao de fāyīn.
examples.en: I want to learn authentic pronunciation.

examples.py: Zhè shì dìdao de Běijīng xiǎochī.
examples.en: This is authentic Beijing snack food.

breakdown: 今(now, present)+年(year) — the present year

examples.en: This year is busier than last year.

breakdown: 延(extend, delay)+长(long) — to make longer

examples.py: Huìyì yáncháng le yí ge xiǎoshí.
examples.en: The meeting was extended by an hour.

examples.cn: 考试时间延长了十分钟。
examples.py: Kǎoshì shíjiān yáncháng le shí fēnzhōng.
examples.en: The exam time was extended by ten minutes.

khmer: ឆ្នាំក្រោយ
breakdown: 明(next, bright)+年(year) — the coming year

examples.en: Next year I want to go to China.

examples.py: Míngnián de jìhuà yǐjīng dìng le.
examples.en: Next year's plan is already set.

examples.py: Wǒ míngnián jiù èrshíyī suì le.

english: to comprehend; to understand; to know about
breakdown: 了(finish, grasp)+解(untie) — you have untied and grasped the meaning

examples.en: I don't know him very well.

examples.py: Nǐ liǎojiě zhè jiàn shì ma?

examples.en: I want to learn about Chinese culture.
He knows this city very well.

examples.cn: 了解以后我就不担心了。
examples.py: Liǎojiě yǐhòu wǒ jiù bù dānxīn le.
examples.en: After understanding it I stopped worrying.

breakdown: 文(writing, civilization)+化(transform) — what shapes and transforms a people

examples.py: Wǒ duì Zhōngguó wénhuà gǎn xìngqù.

examples.cn: 每个国家的文化都不一样。
examples.py: Měi ge guójiā de wénhuà dōu bù yíyàng.
Zhè běn shū jiǎng de shì wénhuà.
Wénhuà hé lìshǐ hěn yǒu guānxi.
examples.en: Culture and history are closely related.

examples.py: Liǎojiě wénhuà cái néng liǎojiě rén.
examples.en: Only by understanding culture can you understand people.

breakdown: 健(strong, 亻person radical)+康(well) — a person who is strong and well

examples.en: Exercise is very good for health.

examples.py: Chī shuǐguǒ duì jiànkāng yǒu bāngzhù.
